invariants: events, evidence, topology, metrics and summary use one tenant, filter set, time window, snapshot_id and as_of
each section reports source watermark, lag and missing reason rather than mixing latest values from different windows
production topology and evidence are backend projections and are never assembled from frontend fixture relationships

data.migration: additive topic_snapshot_manifests and section_watermarks migration required

negative_tests: cross-tenant source sections and topology identifiers are not observable
a section requiring a missing scope is omitted with explicit metadata
a stale or incompatible watermark cannot be presented as a complete snapshot

stop_conditions: snapshot skew, source lag, serialized size or query duration exceeds budget

tests: G1 deterministic manifest and partial semantics
G4 source failure and large-window profile
evidence: one snapshot manifest reconciles every displayed event, evidence and topology section to the same tenant, filters, window and source watermarks
